descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics, we believe that project management is about being the operational backbone of innovation. As a Global Project Manager (GPM), you will be a catalyst for redefining how we deliver impactful diagnostic solutions. We are evolving this role into a strategic orchestration function, where the focus is on enabling value, ensuring end-to-end traceability, and driving operational excellence at a systemic level. We are looking for operational architects who can challenge the status quo. By taking ownership of the links between strategy and execution, connecting cross-functional teams, and building a "single source of truth," you will help elevate the GPM role into a servant-leader position that ensures teams have the space and focus required to innovate. Your Challenges Your mission is to move beyond traditional task-tracking and actively shape the operational health of our global portfolios. Key challenges include:
• Operational Orchestration: Act as a strategic partner ensuring vertical traceability—ensuring that high-level goals are clearly connected to execution units to enable autonomous, high-quality decisions.
• Systemic Flow & Friction Reduction: Proactively identify and resolve structural bottlenecks. You will act as a servant-leader, absorbing operational overhead and administrative friction to protect the core delivery teams.
• Single Source of Truth: Guarantee reliable, consolidated data for tracking investments, capacity, and risks. You will move the organization toward predictive steering rather than reactive reporting.
• Integrated Operating Excellence: Drive the organic adoption of standardized frameworks (Quality, Regulatory, and Methodology) into daily workflows, ensuring compliance is "built-in" rather than an after-the-fact exercise.
• Cross-Domain Connectivity: Facilitate high-level Risk and Opportunity management (ROMA) and coordinate critical integration points between different lifecycles to ensure organizational coherence. ​ Who You Are We need systems-thinkers who are obsessed with efficiency and data integrity.
• Experience: 3+ years leading complex operational frameworks or portfolios in Biotech/Tech. You are comfortable navigating highly regulated environments.
• Expertise: Mastery of the "Ops Stack" (JIRA, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Aha!) and modern frameworks (SAFe, Lean, or Systems Thinking).
• Strategic Impact: Proven ability to translate complex strategy into clear operational execution plans.
• Mindset: A fierce advocate for team autonomy who views "operations" as a product that needs to be optimized for the user. Are you a Project Manager who is tired of chasing status updates? Do you believe that the best leaders don't just "check boxes"—they build the systems that make work flow? At Roche Diagnostics, we are transforming the Global Project Manager role. We are moving away from administrative reporting and toward Operational Intelligence. We are looking for the "Engineers of Value"—people who can connect the dots between high-level strategy and the technical teams delivering life-saving solutions. In this role, you will be the "Operational Pilot" for our most critical Lifecycles:
• You will build the Single Source of Truth: No more fragmented data. You will ensure that strategy and execution are perfectly aligned in our tools and our minds.
